Update :
Conducted a product experience and quality check, including the spa treatments, restaurant offerings, room categories, and overall hotel facilities.

Update :
Their main Bali destinations continue to be Ubud, Nusa Dua, Jimbaran, and Seminyak, with Ubud and Seminyak already supporting our properties.
Current booking activity generally follows a 60+ day booking window, indicating that their clients tend to plan their trips in advance rather than relying heavily on last-minute bookings.
Our minimum-stay benefits and combined-property packages are still being promoted through their channels, and they have already received our contract rates valid through 2028.
2027 pickup is starting from April onwards, although current volume remains relatively limited. Higher airfare continues to be one of the factors affecting future booking demand.
Invited them for a site inspection to refresh their product knowledge and further introduce our latest offerings.
Their key markets remain Belgium and the Netherlands, with opportunities to strengthen production through targeted packages and combined stays.

overview.financial:
As of 1st October 2026, in terms of occupancy for Oct 2026, we are below 15.41% compared to Budget Oct 2026. Following our ADR in the month of Oct 2026, 9.84% below our Budget, and Revenue in the Month of Oct is 25.48% below our Budget.
Our strategy remains driving occupancy in filling up Oct onwards with Last Minute Promotion through ads to boost our direct bookings and doing more Telemarketing. Joining the campaign with OTA to grab more last-minute bookings to maximize the Room Revenue with yield price to hit our ADR and Revenue Budget.
overview.market:
Performance Summary – Blue Karma Dijiwa Seminyak

Reporting Period: Last 30 Days (as of 30 September 2026)

Blue Karma Dijiwa Seminyak maintains strong ADR and excellent guest reviews. The main challenge is increasing booking volume and improving search-to-booking conversion.

 Scores

Property Page: 100% (vs. 100% area avg.)  
Guest Review: 9.3 (vs. 8.7 area avg.)

 Performance Highlights

Room Nights

Aug 31 – Sep 6: 33 (+4.13% vs market)  
Sep 7 – Sep 13: 77 (+153.01%)  
Sep 14 – Sep 20: 63 (+99.24%)  
Sep 21 – Sep 27: 40 (+29.20%)  
Sep 28 – Sep 30: 24 (+46.98%)

➡️ Room nights remained above the market during these periods.

Revenue

Aug 31 – Sep 6: IDR 109.56M (+50.03%)  
Sep 7 – Sep 13: IDR 242.37M (+261.22%)  
Sep 14 – Sep 20: IDR 193.58M (+183.72%)  
Sep 21 – Sep 27: IDR 156.73M (+127.50%)  
Sep 28 – Sep 30: IDR 67.44M (+81.18%)

➡️ Revenue continues to outperform the market on a weekly basis.

 Last 30 Days

Revenue: IDR 584.55M 🔻 -47.96% vs peer group  
Room Nights: 184 🔻 -56.82%  
ADR: IDR 3.18M 🟢 +20.52%

➡️ The main gap is booking volume, while pricing remains strong.

 Next 30 Days

Revenue on Books: IDR 528.01M  
Room Nights: 159  
ADR: IDR 3.32M 🟢 +35.32%  
Cancellation: 51.67% ⚠️

➡️ Forward ADR is strong, but cancellations should be monitored.

 Demand & Search

Demand: 🔻 -7%  
Search Window: 91+ days  
Stay Length: 3–7 nights  
Top Market: Australia (22.65%)

CTR: 2.21% 🔻 -33.41% vs peer group  
Booking Conversion: 1.54% 🔻 -34.53%

➡️ The key opportunity is improving property-page clicks and booking conversion.

 Source Markets – Last 90 Days

265 booked rooms

Australia ~48% | USA ~6% | UK ~6% | Germany ~4% | Netherlands ~4% | Other ~32%

 Summary

Blue Karma Dijiwa Seminyak has strong reviews and premium ADR. The main focus should be increasing booking volume, improving CTR and conversion, and reducing cancellations while maintaining strong pricing.
